reader_summary.headline: Microsoft for Startups is a global program dedicated to helping enterprise-ready B-to-B startups successfully scale their companies.
reader_summary.overview: Microsoft for Startups is a global program dedicated to helping enterprise-ready B-to-B startups successfully scale their companies. The program has been around for a couple of years, but I recently became intrigued when former Invest Like the Best guest, Jeff Ma, took over. Microsoft for Startups provides companies access to technology, including Azure, Cloud, and GitHub.

thesis: The episode argues that software companies should adopt game design principles to shift user perception from viewing tools as work to viewing them as play. This approach relies on five key factors—goals, emotions, toys, controls, and flow—where 'toys' are distinct from 'games' and serve as the foundation for creating products that users love.
